title: OA TABLE 68 - the common martial styles: the four styles with their attack rates, damage dice, armor classes, principal attack forms and special maneuver rank counts, with the explanatory prose
audit_label: R689 OA common martial styles audit
audit_comment: OA round seventy-six (capture pp. 224-225): Table 68 - the common martial styles grid, the four styles across six columns with the explanatory prose, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 68, printed capture pp. 224-225 - the common martial styles round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: the four common styles - Karate the 3/1 at the d6 and AC 8, Hand principal, six maneuver ranks (Strike 1,2,3, Kick 1, Movement 1, Mental 1); Kung-fu the 2/1 at the d6 and AC 6 - the most protective, Hand, eight ranks (Lock 1,2,3, Strike 1,2, Kick 2, Movement 4, Mental 5); Tae Kwon Do the 1/1 at the lone d8 and AC 8, the only Foot principal, six ranks (Kick 1,2,3, Strike 1, Throw 4, Movement 5); Jujutsu the 2/1 at the d6 and AC 7, Hand, the eleven ranks - the most maneuver-rich (Throw 1,2,3,4, Movement 1,3, Vital Area 1,2, Mental 1,2,3). THE PROSE: the attacks style-dependent and possibly different from weapons; the defensive styles low damage; the AC born of the training; the principal form free so long as the body part is - the Karate fist with legs held; the maneuvers the secrets of the art. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 142 closed, 93 open - the Table 68 box flips (census 611 -> 612); NEXT - R690: the Creating a Style doctrine (capture pp. 225-228), prefix djd (verify free at the landing), audit "R690 OA creating a style audit", include after rules/oa68styles.h

consts.name: djcOA68StyleCount
consts.comment: the Table 68 style count - the four common martial styles (Karate, Kung-fu, Tae Kwon Do, Jujutsu), the loop bound of the emitted grid audit (print capture p. 224)

bools.name: djcOA68AttacksStyleDependent
bools.comment: the attacks explanation - the number of attacks depends on the style used and may differ from the number of attacks with weapons, a character's ability to attack able to increase, decrease or remain the same when using martial arts (print capture p. 225)

bools.name: djcOA68DamageDefensiveLow
bools.comment: the damage explanation - the damage die rolled to determine the effect of a hit, the defensive styles generally doing low damage, the offensive the opposite (print capture p. 225)

bools.name: djcOA68ACFromTraining
bools.comment: the armor class explanation - a measure of the degree of protection the character gains when using the style, the protection coming from the training that allows him to avoid, deflect or withstand blows (print capture p. 225)

bools.name: djcOA68PrincipalBodyPartFree
bools.comment: the principal attack form explanation - the part or parts of body most often used, the attacks continuing so long as the listed body part is free - Karate emphasizing the fist, the character attacking even though his legs may be held (print capture p. 225)

bools.name: djcOA68ManeuversSecrets
bools.comment: the special maneuvers explanation - the secrets of the art allowing fantastic feats but difficult to learn: Backward Kick, Sticking Touch, Great Throw, Ironskin and other normally impossible abilities (print capture p. 225)
